selectionPolicy.note: Match the page's intention to an entry, then confirm with triggers. Layouts are the unit of selection; components resolve via dependsOn.

as-is-to-be.intent: contrast the current experience with the improved one using real screens

centered-question-evidence.intent: open a section with a framing question, then back it with parallel proofs
triggers: a question to anchor a section

citation-card.intent: back a claim with a traceable source

comparison-table.intent: help the audience choose by comparing options across criteria with one highlighted

cta-buttons.intent: offer one clear primary action plus a quieter secondary

delta-metric.intent: prove a change by pairing a big +/-% with its before/after bars

editorial-explainer-stage.intent: humanize workshop instructions, workflow transformation, or real-UI interpretation

evidence-card.intent: carry one piece of proof - an icon-stat, a chart, or a logo-row
triggers: one proof card in a trio

feature-card.intent: present one feature with an icon, a title, and a short description

feature-grid.intent: present a small set of features as equal, scannable cards
triggers: a 2×2 of capabilities each with an icon + blurb

feature-showcase.intent: show how specific UI features deliver value / resolve user anxieties

triggers: X of Y in the capital area

triggers: 一個主軸展開幾個面向

icon-label-row.intent: list items with a quick visual anchor per row

idea-evidence.intent: pair a design idea with the evidence that backs it
triggers: an idea/claim + a supporting chart or stat

interview-affinity.intent: converge several interview groups into one shared insight

keyword-cards.intent: present a few parallel values / keywords / principles as equal cards
triggers: parallel ideas each with a short explanation

level-slider.intent: show a trait/level at a glance (low ↔ high)

linked-circles.intent: show that several concepts connect into one continuous whole (a continuum / total experience)

logo-row.intent: evidence what exists by showing the actual marks

metric-card.intent: state one outcome so the number is the hero and the topic is labeled quietly

numbered-rows.intent: explain 2-4 sequenced points, each backed by its own chart
